answer_1.quote: We propose the task of expository text generation.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of the generated documents with two sets of metrics. First, we use traditional metrics. ROUGE-1 (R1) and ROUGE-2 (R2) , BLEU , and ME-TEOR  measure the similarity between the predicted and true outputs.

answer_4.quote: we invite two computer science and engineering college students to evaluate 30 random expository documents in the test sets produced by each baseline on U.S. News and Medline.
answer_4.guideline: we ask annotators to evaluate on Style adherence to the true output (i.e. organization and phrasing), and Factuality on a 5-Likert scale.
